doc.title: Spiegle Willcox and Al Gallodoro interviewed by Monk Rowe, Norwich, New York, November 14, 1995

title: Who was in the Isham Jones band
summary: Willcox asks about trumpeter Paniccio; Gallodoro names George Thow, an unnamed trombonist Sonny and bass trombonist Red Ballard.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Was there a trumpet player Paniccio?
Oh, I know that name now.
Was he in the band then?
Not when I was in, no.
George Thow was the jazz trumpet player when I was in it. Sonny something was the trombone player. Sonny, oh, goodness I can’t think of his last name.
And Red Ballard was the bass trombone.
Yeah Red Ballard. I remember the name.
Oh, we could keep going here.
